Message.MsgText: The SCIM server URL is not specified.

Explanation.p: The required parameter for SCIM server URL (ServerURL) is not specified in the SCIM Connector.

OperatorResponse.p: Specify the SCIM server URL parameter in the connector.

Message.MsgText: The SCIM resource endpoint is not specified.

Explanation.p: The resource endpoint parameter is not specified in the SCIM connector, and the provided entry does not have an endpoint attribute.

OperatorResponse.p: Specify the resource endpoint parameter in the connector, or use an endpoint attribute in the conn entry.

Message.MsgText: The ID attribute is missing in the conn entry.

Explanation.p: The provided conn entry does not contain an ID attribute. The ID attribute is required for the attempted operation.

OperatorResponse.p: Specify an ID attribute in the conn entry.

Explanation.p: The link criteria should only use operators that can be used in a SCIM filter.

OperatorResponse.p: Use another operator in the link criteria.
